name: Corpo API
summary: Official company-register lookups by jurisdiction: profiles, officers, charges, insolvency, shareholders, financials, ownership and VAT checks.

api_key.description: a Corpo API key (ck_live_..., or ck_test_... which is never billed) from the dashboard at https://corpoapi.com/app

notes: Rate limit per key: free 5/s and 100/min, paying 50/s and 2,000/min; 429 carries Retry-After.
List endpoints page by opaque cursor (limit 1-100, default 20): send pagination.next_cursor back as cursor with the same filters.
Coverage differs by country: a 409 means the register does not publish that block. Check corpoapi.coverage.get.

endpoints.name: Search company registers
endpoints.summary: Find companies in one official register by name or registration number.

q.description: A company name, or a registration number or identifier; at least 2 characters.

jurisdiction.description: The one jurisdiction to search (e.g. se, gb, us-de).

status.description: Restrict to normalised statuses such as active or dissolved; repeat or comma-separate.

legal_form.description: Restrict to register legal-form codes, e.g. AB-ORGFO.

active_only.description: Shortcut for status=active; excludes dissolved and struck-off companies.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from pagination.next_cursor of the previous page; send it with the same filters.

notes: One jurisdiction per request. Paging is by cursor: send pagination.next_cursor back as cursor.
Returns ranked identification fields; fetch the full record with corpoapi.company.get.

endpoints.name: Get a company profile
endpoints.summary: One consistent company profile from the official register.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 such as se or gb, or a subdivision such as us-de.

company_number.description: Company number or any identifier the register publishes. Percent-encode reserved characters such as /.

include.description: Blocks to include: identifiers, activity, other_names, legal_form, links, lei. Defaults to all.

endpoints.name: Verify a company against the register
endpoints.summary: Resolve one company and compare supplied claims with register data.

company_number.description: Preferred identifier; any identifier the register publishes.

name.description: Used when company_number is absent; must resolve to exactly one company.

expected.description: Claims to compare: {legal_name, status (active or any), address_postcode, address_line1, vat_number, officer_names (max 20)}.

Idempotency-Key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the stored response and is never billed twice.

notes: A read over POST: it changes nothing. Result is verified, partial, mismatch, not_found or ambiguous.
With no expected claims, verified only means a company was found. One paid call (USD 0.05) when found; repeats for the same company on the same UTC day are free.
